description: Jiateng Guo and Xuechuang Xu publish engineering borehole information in an Access database and two CSV exports. The Zenodo description defines fields for borehole coordinates and elevation, layer thickness and bottom depth, borehole identifiers, engineering indices, and hierarchical layer labels. The 2023 deposit is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. These tables can supply stratigraphic inputs for ground models used in foundation, tunnelling or buried-infrastructure simulations. Coverage is a research borehole collection whose site, country, drilling dates, coordinate reference and measurement units are not stated. Those unknowns must be resolved before combining it with georeferenced engineering records. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this database. The CSV exports offer an access route independent of Microsoft Access, but field consistency and geological interpretations were not checked because the data were not downloaded.
